summary: Southern Company Gas Capital Corporation priced $550 million of Series 2026A 5.00% senior notes due October 1, 2029, guaranteed by parent Southern Company Gas (GAS). The September 9, 2026 underwriting agreement was led by BofA Securities, MUFG Securities Americas, PNC Capital Markets and Wells Fargo Securities as representatives. Notes were registered under an existing shelf registration statement, with Troutman Pepper Locke and Balch Bingham providing legal and tax opinions. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown by a natural gas distribution utility, not a special situation; proceeds support general corporate purposes and no equity, M&A or structural event is implicated.
